mapper.select: select h.id, h.object_type as objectType, h.object_id as objectId, h.from_status as fromStatus, h.to_status as toStatus, h.operator_id as operatorId, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),u.user_name) as operatorName, h.reason, h.trace_id as traceId, h.create_time as createTime from lab_status_history h left join sys_user u on u.user_id=h.operator_id and u.del_flag='0' where h.del_flag='0' and ((h.object_type='RESERVATION' and h.object_id=#{reservationId}) or (h.object_type='REPAIR_ORDER' and h.object_id=#{repairId})) order by h.create_time desc,h.id desc limit #{limit}

select id,title,delivery_status as status,create_time as createTime, content as reason,'DIRECT_RELATION' as basis from lab_notification where receiver_id=#{receiverId} and delivery_status='SENT' and ((business_type='RESERVATION' and business_id=#{reservationId}) or (business_type='USAGE_RECORD' and business_id=#{usageId}) or (business_type='REPAIR_ORDER' and business_id=#{repairId})) order by create_time desc,id desc limit #{limit}
